title: QWR-2: Quad-Write Receipt No. 2 — First Real Metrics of the 60-Day Run (DRIFT-1 Report, Epoch 20261019)
description:
QWR-2 — THE SECOND QUAD-WRITE ON RECORD. One SHA-256 digest, four mainnets, one joint pre-broadcast commitment. The quad-written artifact is the DRIFT-1 report: the first measured (not projected, not simulated) drift metrics of the SQUIRL OS 60-day sustained run — 280 real weight updates, total drift 0.0094 contained; governance roster SHA-256 byte-identical before and after training (cd45a44e...); determinism byte-identical across replays (4beb1771...); 68/68 old-corpus preservation; 0 false positives; 7/7 epoch falsifiers. Wall context: 109/109 falsifiers held, 0 escapes, 54 receipted adversarial/containment cycles.

Rails and identifiers of record: Bitcoin canonical txid a02b22db8fcd89bc5fc13f51cb3c84abeafb3055b023051d0b9ac0d1914eba0f (OP_RETURN, non-witness serialization); XRPL AccountSet txid E3883E43A2249FB180042D60D426F9ABAF53FFA016EDB5A01D425C6742FDA2AA (ledger 107764054, memo SQDR-XRP-STORE-5); Stellar NETWORK hash d47691a894b85a09f5ec5e532591bd401642459db5ab4a3c138bc2c4a4f18fac (ledger 65027198, ManageData SQDR-STORE-4 + memo_hash); Cardano transaction hash f8d37e9309d3c40a90f2c399a82d1965c190e714f16570184becf7b4a64e6955 (block 14089165, metadata label 1967, blake2b256 over tx body CBOR). All four read back keyless and byte-exact. Total postage: 700 sats + 10 drops + 200 stroops + 0.17 ADA.

Disclosed defects (honesty spine): the LINDY-B 2026-10-17 slot miss and same-night repair; the cage-watch feed count drift (53 vs 54, forward-only sync, commit 3fc5feb); and the QWR-1 prereg prose correction — the Cardano transaction hash convention is blake2b256 over the tx body CBOR (the QWR-1 on-chain identifier was always correct and byte-exact on-chain; the prose label was imprecise). Training instances are generated faults; no production, customer, or personal data (POL-DISC-001).

Program benchmark: MEASURED (scoped) — all ceremony gates deterministic, no LLM in any decision path (program benchmark DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23321637). Dual Mesh Benchmark: MEASURED (scoped) — DeepSeek column, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23345241. Full receipt corpus: github.com/LLong2026/four-horsemen.
